caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical, rectangular garden or estate plan enclosed by a dark brown border. There are three small structures: a tan-roofed house at the top center, a small church-like building with a pointed roof at the top right, and an arched entrance pavilion at the bottom center, each with white walls and brownish-orange roofs. The layout consists of eight rectangular or square sections, arranged in two vertical columns and four rows. The sections are outlined with double green lines and separated by wide tan pathways. The upper two sections each contain evenly spaced green trees on a tan background. The six lower sections contain elaborate geometric designs of hedges in shades of green, with additional accents in yellow-green at the center of two sections and the bottom left section. Several sections feature corner circles, likely representing topiary or small trees. The overall background is a light beige color. The artist’s name “Helen E. Miller” is written in the bottom right corner.
title: West India Company's Garden
